Name: (CP) Better Bathing Suit
Author: TeacupCreations
Description:
Ever thought the default bathing suit looks a bit... clunky? Want a bikini that is sleek but not too revealing?
This mod replaces the default bathing suit (ie. the bikini you change into in the bath house) with a more flattering version.

[b]Now with more options!
[/b]You can change the tops, bottoms, and sandals in the mod config menu:
[list]
[*]Tops: Bare, Bikini, Binder
[*]Bottoms: Bare, Bikini, Boxers
[*]Feet: Sandals, Bare
[/list]
[b]Bathing Suits out and about
[/b]Now you can wear the better bathing suits out in town. Download the optional 'Wearable Better Bathing Suit' file to add the bikini top and bottom as clothing items. You can buy them at Sandy's shop or spawn the item.

[b]Limitations & Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] [s]I may add more options later but at present this only works on a 'female' farmer base.[/s]
[*]This mod replaces the base sprite as well as assets for all vanilla clothing so may interact poorly with other mods that do that same.
[*][s]This mod will not work when wearing pants that have custom assets as they all have a hidden 'bikini' layer.[/s] Mod no longer messes up custom pants. They will still turn into the vanilla bathing suit though.
[/list]
